title: THE SUB-BASEMENT IS A DEATH TRAP! 💀

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: THE SUB-BASEMENT DOOR IS BLEEDING [beat] AND THE LOCK HAS BEEN WELDED SHUT FROM THE INSIDE!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Look at these monitors [beat] Jamal isn't just hiding here, he’s been live-streaming our entire house for months!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Every private conversation [beat] every secret we thought we buried in the attic, he’s got it all on these hard drives!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: You should have stayed in the gas chamber [beat] because curiosity doesn't just kill cats, it bankrupts families!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: You absolute snake [beat] you stole the inheritance money just to build this disgusting high-tech dungeon!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: It wasn't just about the money [beat] it was about watching you all scramble like rats in a maze I built!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Wait [beat] the server rack is ticking, and I don't think that's the sound of a cooling fan failing!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: He’s rigged the whole sub-basement to incinerate [beat] he’s going to erase the evidence and us with it!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: The data is already in the cloud [beat] but your physical presence has become a bit of a liability, Nix!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: The vents are closing [beat] we're trapped in a lead-lined box with a digital timer counting down to zero!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Riku, use your bypass key [beat] if you can't hack this door in ten seconds, we’re literal toast!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The firewall is too thick [beat] but I see a manual override lever behind that glass panel over the furnace!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I’m going for it [beat] even if I have to reach through the flames to pull that lever down!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Too late [beat] the system just initiated the final purge sequence and the air is getting very thin!
